__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: CoreLink S-08 Rate Limit + Quota CAS + Edge + Abuse + Global Circuit metrics datasource (Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics / Grafana Cloud)

title: CoreLink — Rate Limit + Quota CAS + Edge + Abuse + Global Circuit (DASH-RATE)
description: WI-S08-006 §6.1 canonical S-08 ship-gate dashboard. Mirrors DASH-DEDUP / DASH-GC pattern. Aggregates 4-camada bulkhead operational visibility per sprint contract §4 PAT-RATE-LIMIT-001: camada 0 global circuit (corelink-rate-headers) + camada 1 per-tenant DO RateLimiter (corelink-ratelimit) + camada 2 CF edge per-IP (corelink-edge) + camada 3 quota CAS hard-block (corelink-quota-cas) + camada 4 abuse heuristic (corelink-abuse). SLI distinction within-quota vs over-quota (sprint contract §7.10.s08.1 critical). PRR HIGH_RISK 11 sign-offs canonical.

panels.title: SLI distinction: within-quota 429 (BUG; in SLO denominator) vs over-quota 429 (LEGITIMATE; excluded)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 1 + sprint contract §7.10.s08.1 CRITICAL. The 5-arm X-Rate-Limit-Type taxonomy (R-S08-8) splits the 429 stream into within-quota (tenant_quota + global_circuit_open — counts in SLI denominator) vs over-quota (per_ip + per_pat + over_quota — excluded). Property test prop_x_rate_limit_type_5_arm_canonical pins the taxonomy. Regression detection: SEV-1 alert sli-distinction-regression at delta > 10% over 5min.

panels.title: SLO-AVAIL-CAS-GET (within-quota only; sprint contract §7.10.s08.1)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 2 + SLO-CATALOG SLI-AVAIL-CAS-GET. Numerator = success_total. Denominator = success_total + within_quota_429 (rate_limited_over_quota EXCLUDED per sprint contract §7.10.s08.1). 30d error budget window. Target 99.9%.

panels.title: Camada 0: Global circuit state per region (0=Closed, 1=HalfOpen, 2=Open)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 3 + WI-S08-005 InMemoryGlobalCircuitBreaker. Multi-signal trip canonical (5xx_rate + p99_latency); single-signal alarm SEV-3 (R-S08-004 false-positive mitigation). Manual override SEV-2.

panels.title: Camada 0: Global circuit trips + recoveries (last 30d)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 4 + WI-S08-005. Trips by reason (5xx_rate / p99_latency / multi_signal); recoveries via HalfOpen probe (one-through). Single-signal alarm SEV-3 informational.

panels.title: Camada 1: Per-tenant DO RateLimiter — token bucket utilization (top 50)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 5 + WI-S08-001 InMemoryTokenBucketRateLimiter. Tokens remaining gauge per (tenant, dimension) tier-aware refill ladder canonical 5-tier free/solo/team/business/enterprise per Lote 10.7bis P0-7. Top-50 enforced cardinality bound.

panels.title: INV-AVAIL-ISOLATION canary: cross_tenant_violation_total (MUST = 0; SEV-1 alert)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 6 + sprint contract §8 INV-AVAIL-ISOLATION (HIGH; registry §3.8). corelink_ratelimit_cross_tenant_violation_total + corelink_abuse_cross_tenant_feature_leak_total MUST always = 0; > 0 = SEV-1 PagerDuty page Architect + Security Lead. Cross-validated by prop_tenant_isolation @ 10k iter on every per-WI prop suite.

panels.title: Camada 2: CF edge per-IP — block decisions + CIDR blocklist size
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 7 + WI-S08-002 InMemoryCidrBlocklist longest-prefix-match. EdgeDecision 3-arm (Allow / DenyBlocklisted / DenyAbuse). Blocklist size IPv4 + IPv6 gauge; SEV-2 if size > capacity 100k.

panels.title: Camada 3: Quota CAS — atomic check decisions + race detection
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 8 + WI-S08-003 InMemoryAtomicQuotaChecker. CAS decision 3-arm (allow / deny_429 / race_detected). Race detection rate sustained > 0.1/s = SEV-3 (informational; bounded retry succeeds within 3 attempts canonical). Hard-block 100% (CAP-QUOTA-001 per ADR-0020 FROZEN supersedes S-07 PROVISIONAL).

panels.title: Camada 4: Abuse heuristic — score distribution + tier counts
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 9 + WI-S08-004 InMemoryAbuseScorer. 4-feature canonical weighted-sum (cpu_wallclock_ratio + egress_bytes_per_min + action_digest_entropy_bits + concurrent_exec_count). 3-arm decision Benign/Suspicious/Malicious at 0.5/0.8 thresholds. Calibration n=50/50 95% CI: 0/50 FP (Wilson upper 0.071) + 50/50 TP (Wilson lower 0.929).

panels.title: LGPD canary: auto_suspend_attempts (MUST = 0; SEV-1 alert; LGPD Art. 20 + GDPR Art. 22)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 10 + sprint contract §7.10.s08.3. AbuseError::AutoSuspendForbidden trap on programmatic suspend attempts; humane response canonical (admin manual review only). Counter MUST always = 0; non-zero = SEV-1 PagerDuty page Compliance Officer + Privacy Officer.

panels.title: RFC 9331 header emission rate — canonical 5-arm X-Rate-Limit-Type taxonomy
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 11 + sprint contract §5 R-S08-8 + sprint contract §9.14.s08.5 RFC 9331 compliance. 5-arm canonical (tenant_quota / per_ip / per_pat / over_quota / global_circuit_open). Marketing-claim defensibility: RFC 9331 (RateLimit + RateLimit-Policy) replaces custom X-Rate-Limit-* per IETF stable draft.

panels.title: Bulkhead 4-camada decision rate (per-camada; PAT-RATE-LIMIT-001)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 12 + sprint contract §4 PAT-RATE-LIMIT-001. Defense-in-depth observability: edge → ratelimit → quota-CAS → abuse layered decision rate. Sustained imbalance signals upstream camada starving downstream.

panels.title: INV-RATE-LIMIT-PROPORTIONALITY canary: refill_rate × tier consistency (sprint contract §8 NEW)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 13 + sprint contract §8 INV-RATE-LIMIT-PROPORTIONALITY (NEW HIGH). plan_sync_lag_ms gauge sustained > 5 min = SEV-2 (plan change not propagated). Cross-validated by prop_token_bucket_proportionality + prop_token_bucket_never_exceeds_capacity at 10k iter PR-gate.

panels.title: PRR HIGH_RISK 11 sign-offs canonical ship gate status (per framework §33.5.4.3 + ADR-0034)
panels.description: WI §6.1 panel 14 + sprint contract §6 DoD HIGH_RISK 11 sign-offs canonical. Owner + Final Approver + Architect (Crypto SME co-sign for race correctness atomic CAS) + Security Lead + SRE Lead + Engineer + QA Lead + Product + Compliance + Privacy + AppSec advisor. Status APPROVED vs WAIVED-via-ADR-0034 (solo-tier dual-hat). Ship gate REJECTED if any seat missing both APPROVED + WAIVED.
